findings.one_line: The promised global symbolic frontier R_n^DP asymp max{R_n^NP,rho_n^priv} is not delivered: this theorem matches only for q >= q_0 or privacy-leading rho_n^priv, leaving the below-elbow privacy-inactive region open.

This open question explicitly retains the missing privacy-transfer/attainment step, so the current artifact supplies a conditional frontier rather than the proposal's claimed full incremental-private-price theorem.
